description: Taiga is an open-source project management platform for agile teams. It supports Scrum and Kanban methodologies, with features like user stories, tasks, sprints, epics, issues tracking, and a wiki.

onboarding_steps.title: Welcome & Landing Page Overview
onboarding_steps.description: Show the user the Taiga landing page and explain what Taiga is.

tasks.narration: This is the Taiga homepage. Taiga is an open-source project management tool designed for agile teams.
As you can see, Taiga supports both Scrum and Kanban methodologies, making it flexible for different team workflows.

onboarding_steps.title: Explore Key Features
onboarding_steps.description: Walk through the main features highlighted on the landing page.

tasks.narration: Let me show you some of the key features. Taiga offers user stories, task management, sprint planning, and issue tracking.
It also has a built-in wiki for documentation and supports integrations with popular tools.

faq.question: What is Taiga used for?
faq.answer: Taiga is used for project management, particularly for agile software development teams. It supports Scrum and Kanban workflows.

faq.question: Is Taiga free to use?
faq.answer: Yes, Taiga is open-source and free to use. You can self-host it or use their cloud offering.

faq.question: What methodologies does Taiga support?
faq.answer: Taiga supports both Scrum and Kanban methodologies. You can choose the one that best fits your team's workflow.

faq.question: Can I self-host Taiga?
faq.answer: Yes, Taiga is fully open-source and can be self-hosted. They provide Docker images and documentation for self-hosting.

faq.question: What are user stories in Taiga?
faq.answer: User stories in Taiga represent features or requirements from the user's perspective. They can be organized into sprints, assigned to team members, and tracked through various stages.

faq.question: Does Taiga have integrations?
faq.answer: Yes, Taiga supports integrations with tools like GitHub, GitLab, Slack, and webhooks for custom integrations.
